in_marathi.name: Jithendra
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jithendra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jitendra is derived from two Sanskrit words, 'jita' meaning victory or conquer and 'indra' meaning lord or king. The name is a tribute to the Hindu god Indra, who is the lord of the heavens, rain, and thunderbolts. This name is given to boys to inspire courage, strength, and leadership.
